note: Round-wise closing scores from official allotment data. One row per university + college + program + category + round + year. Fill from the universities' published allotment lists; the predictor reads only this file.

fields.university: as named in universities.json, e.g. University of Delhi
fields.category: UR | OBC-NCL | EWS | SC | ST | PwBD
fields.scoreType: merit (DU combined merit score) | subject (single-subject NTA score)
fields.subjects: required CUET subjects; each inner list means 'any one of', e.g. [["Mathematics"], ["English", "Hindi"]]
fields.source: link to the official allotment list
